rongmei.title: Jisu kei dat nimei kagan naguang

lines: 1. Jisu kei dat nimei kagan nguang puthe,
Hei kandih luai pukhou chamdan latho;
Jatguai kamei guang khou kasuan lakhang,
Tingpuk kandih guai manpui nung kiu.
Chorus:
Tingkauh chang khou ai tat pukhou,
Guang bampang khou guang kariu ni;
Halleluijah jat guaina )_3,
Guang bampang khou suan na bam ni.
2. Kaokei pui khuantei le Raguang bangun khun le,
Kamei kahak kei puni Khrista khou thei kanmei;
Jianmei guai tei thao rei puni,
Mitang ring bammei le kariu ni.
3. Tingkauh kaidai khou ganmei )_3 padik e,
Khou tei Khrista lung bam e;
Kamei le bam chamni muang rukhou
Rui phung kuni.
4. Nphuanmei pheiban )_3 apuan suna lung ni,
Khrista )_3 ganmei bam khou kata thuan;
Mei khuan)_3, trumpet khuan le alim khuan )_3,
Tingkauh kaidai khou thuan na bam ni.
Favourite song: Samson Pastor
